name: Magus

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Passes For Human
bonuses.text: A DN 3 Awareness (Int) Test is required to notice a Magus is not Human.

bonuses.name: Spiritual Leader
bonuses.text: Allied GENESTEALER CULT Threats within 10m of the Magus gain +4 bonus to dice to resist psychic powers.

abilities.name: Cult Recruitment
abilities.text: The Magus attempts to activate Possession (Wrath & Glory, page 281)

abilities.name: Broodmind
abilities.text: The Magus may attempt to activate any of the following psychic powers: Smite (Wrath & Glory page 272), Psyniscience (page 267), Deny the Witch (page 267), Compel (page 268), Fog the Mind (page 279), Psychic Shriek (page 279), Terrify (page 280).

abilities.name: Broodmind
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Magus attempts to activate a Psychic Power or Deny the Witch.

note: Reprint of cult-magus; differs in name, keywords, Tier row (adds Tier 5), Resilience 9 (Core 5), Force Stave 8 (Core 12) and Bio-dagger, Autopistol Salvo 2.
